explanation: This converts the actual variable-size catalog packing into a finite total storage bound. It bounds the sum of the packed level extents by the number of levels times one uniform per-level reservation.
theorem_title: Total shared-level offset is bounded by the cell envelope
theorem_formal_statement: theorem ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SharedReportingBankResourceBounds.offset_le (h J : ℕ) : _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SharedReportingBankLevels.offset h J (_root_.ThreeSum.SharedReportingBankHeader.levels J) ≤ _root_.ThreeSum.SharedReportingBankHeader.levels J*_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SharedReportingBankResourceBounds.cellBound h J := by sorry
theorem_natural_language_statement:
For every $h,J\in\mathbb N$, write $K(J)$ for the number of prescribed reporting levels and $C(h,J)$ for the uniform per-level cell bound. The packed level offset satisfies

$$\operatorname{offset}(h,J,K(J))\le K(J)C(h,J).$$

This converts the actual variable-size catalog packing into a finite total storage bound.
